name: Grapes
overview: Scripture uses grapes and their products to illustrate both spiritual truths and practical warnings. The vine and its fruit symbolize life and connection to Christ, the true vine, whose Father tends His people (John 15:1). Grapes and wine also serve as cautions against excess and deception, highlighting the dangers of drunkenness and strong drink (Proverbs 20:1; Ephesians 5:18; Numbers 6:3). Additionally, the imagery of ripe grapes in judgment (Revelation 14:18) and the proverb about sour grapes (Ezekiel 18:2) reflect God's justice and the consequences of sin across generations.
